button.note: big silence button over SW1, now a 12 x 12 x 4.3 low-profile tact switch (Rev A: 7.3)

pir.note: Ø10.8 board cutout: the AM312 drops through it onto a boss in the bottom plate (its base 1.9 below the board's underside); legs reach the board by 3 short wires

speaker.note: Ø20 x 4 mm 8 Ω micro speaker (replaces the BZ1 piezo) on a 0.3 mm foam pad, held down by the lid: no parts in this Ø21 circle; two wire pads beside it

eye_led_l.note: white 0603 LED under the left eye's highlight light pipe (pipe ends 1.4 above the board); flashes with the alarm

eye_led_r.note: white 0603 LED under the right eye's highlight light pipe

power_switch.note: C&K OS102011MA1Q right-angle slide switch (body centre); its 4 mm lever leaves the body face at x 34, centre 2.6 mm below the board (enclosure z 10.9), tip flush with the base's outer wall in a thumb pocket; in series with battery +

module.note: suggested: U2 ESP32-C3-WROOM-02 moves to the bottom face so the eye LEDs get the top; antenna end on the +y edge, clear of the cells

amp.note: U3 MAX98357A, now driving the speaker

cells.note: 2 x AAA in a cradle in the bottom plate, 0.9 mm below the bottom face: no parts here, THT leads clipped to 0.5
